sloka: कस्य वा ते प्रियं कार्यं केन वा विप्रियं कृतम् ।कः प्रियं लभतामद्य को वा सुमहदप्रियम् ॥२-१०-३१॥
transliteration: kasya vā te priyaṁ kāryaṁ kena vā vipriyaṁ kṛtam ।kaḥ priyaṁ labhatāmadya ko vā sumahadapriyam ॥2-10-31॥

translations.english: On whom do you wish to bestow favour? Who has caused you displeasure? To whom should I grant favour now? To whom should I cause great displeasure?
